summary: Not as a dip signal: buying as KC %B crossed down through 0.1 or sat below 0 did the same as random on 1h, 4h and daily. The result that holds up is at the upper band, where shorting above 1 did worse than random on all three timeframes. The cross up through 1 beat random on 4h and daily, but because price moved more after those volatile candles in a window that rose.

verdicts.use: Buying the dip (crosses down 0.1 or below 0)
verdicts.text: Same as random on 1h, 4h and daily, as a cross down through 0.1 or as a level below 0.
Same as random on 1h and 4h. On daily it fired too rarely to judge.
Beat random on 4h and daily, and was fragile on 1h. These crosses fire in volatile candles, so price moved more after them in a window that rose; it is not a read on direction.
Worse than random on 1h, 4h and daily. Price kept rising after %B went above 1, most of all in uptrends.

notes: Buying as KC %B crossed down through 0.1 on 1h gave 4,646 entries in 1,979 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.06% ahead of random entries, inside the luck band of -0.14% to 0.16%. Holding below 0 enters nearly twice as often and was also the same as random on 1h, 4h and daily. Length 7 crossing down 0 fires about a fifth as often as the 0.1 cross on 1h and lands in the same place.

Some losing dip results rest on one coin or one stretch. On 4h, SOL alone did 1.41% worse than random after a cross down through 0.1, and that held without its strongest stretch and at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles. Length 7 crossing down 0 on 4h SOL looked 3.16% worse, but only because of signals on Nov 7–9, 2022, during the FTX collapse. Below 0 on 4h in downtrends looked 0.82% worse only because of entries between Jun 10, 2022 and Jun 18, 2022.

Going long as %B crossed up through 1 beat random entries by 0.79% on 4h, above a luck band that topped out at 0.57%. It holds without its strongest stretch and shows at 10, 20 and 100 candles, but not at 50. Uptrends carry it: 0.95% above random there, while in downtrends it was the same as random.

On daily the cross up through 1 beat random by 8.5% after 20 days. In uptrends that gap rests on entries between Jul 31, 2021 and Aug 27, 2021, and downtrends had too few moves to judge. On 1h it was fragile, resting on signals on Nov 5–7, 2020. These crosses fire mostly in volatile candles, so price moved more after them in a window that rose; that is timing, not a read on direction.

Shorting while %B was above 1 did 0.36% worse than random after 20 candles on 1h, 1.17% worse on 4h and 8.4% worse after 20 days on daily. On 1h and 4h it shows at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles and holds without its strongest stretch. On 4h it was 1.11% worse in uptrends and the same as random in downtrends. On 1h the downtrend result rests on May 8–9, 2025, and on daily the downtrend side had too few moves to judge.

For a long DCA bot, dip timing from KC %B adds nothing on these pairs, and the DCA orders and take profit do the work. Above 1, price kept going, so a short bot that opens above the upper band trades against the trend; leave that start condition out, most of all in uptrends. The cross up through 1 is worth testing only as a filter beside a trend condition, because its gap comes from when it fires. In falling markets it did the same as random.
